propositions: Four graph functions (_find_direct_blockers, _get_all_blocked_by, check_cycle_at_level, detect_newly_unblocked) have elevated cyclomatic complexity (16–22) driven by duplicated reduce_all loops and re-implemented BFS skeletons.

An identical 'reduce_all_tickets → drop error/fsck_needed → index by id' loop is duplicated verbatim in _find_direct_blockers and _compute_dep_graph, and BFS traversal logic is duplicated in _get_all_blocked_by and check_cycle_at_level.

Introducing load_indexed_states (graph/_loader.py) to deduplicate the reduce_all pattern and bfs (graph/_relations.py) as an accumulator-returning skeleton will reduce all four functions' CCN to ≤8 and ≤12 while preserving node-sets and traversal results identically.

The refactored bfs must pass visited as read-only to neighbors_fn and return the accumulator set (including blocks targets with no backing dir, excluding the seed) to preserve _get_all_blocked_by and check_cycle_at_level's semantics.

Existing test suites (tests/scripts/graph/, tests/scripts/test_ticket_unblock.py) must pass unmodified, and a new characterization test must verify _get_all_blocked_by includes unreferenced targets and excludes the seed id.
